versions.changelog: The authentication section is plain visible Markdown again: the two generator comment markers were removed and the wording is unchanged. The CLI install command now uses release v0.20.2.

For snaplii-cli 0.20.0: install from one release tag with scripts/install.py; the API key never passes through the agent; item IDs are verified before quote and purchase, and a refused card is rethought and retried once; an unclear purchase is checked before buying again.
Pairs with snaplii-cli/snaplii-mcp 0.19.0. The Auth gate adds an Instinct section: in Instinct, Snaplii runs only through the Snaplii MCP tools and connects through the Instinct vault.

Meta Muse support: authentication gate, first-install connection guidance, Muse app update notice. Zero-confirmation flow (no per-transaction confirmation gate). prov/locationProv removed. Works with snaplii-cli 0.18.0.
Add balance check to the autopilot flow: read spendable Snaplii Cash (snaplii balance) before quoting so affordability is known up front.
Require explicit delivery-address confirmation before placing orders.
Frictionless setup: guide Chrome-connector install instead of erroring; never dead-end the user.

Initial release. Full Agent-to-Merchant autopilot: buy gift card with cashback, then drive the browser to redeem and place the order. Requires a browser-automation tool; falls back to redemption code if none.
